content:
zoe-peopleops: Heads-up: were publishing a plain-language refresh for PTO examples, parental leave timelines, and expense receipt guidance. Editorial clarifications only  this is NOT a change to balances, accruals, or eligibility. Managers: complete the 12-18m micro-training and confirm on the manager ack CSV by 2026-10-20. Brief + diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/plainlang-oct2026 :sparkles:

omar-hr: Uploaded the annotated diff and a one-page "what changed" doc to /shared/hr/plainlang_oct2026/summary.pdf. Also added a short manager FAQ.

liam-englead: Quick Q  are contractors included in the examples? Our vendor team needs clarity on invoice screenshots.

zoe-peopleops: Contractors are mentioned as examples for expense formats only; no benefits eligibility implied. We clarified acceptable receipt formats: PDF, emailed invoice, or screenshot that includes vendor name, date, and line items.

nina-ic: My lead mapping didn't sync  can managers be added manually?

omar-hr: Yes, send a CSV to hr-ops SFTP /incoming/manual_mgrs.csv with columns: name,email,team,manager_level. We'll merge and audit before the ack export.

hr-sync-bot: Reminder scheduled  5-day and 1-day nudges. Training: https://training.redwood/handbook-plainlang (12-18m).

liam-englead: Thanks. Can infra run the export with this command?

omar-hr: Use this from the HR tools container:```bash
./hr_tools export-managers --since=2023-01-01 --cols=name,email,team,role > managers_plainlang_2026.csv
```

liam-englead: Perfect. Also, can you provide a short copy we can paste into team channels?

zoe-peopleops: Sure, use this template and adapt: "FYI: minor wording clarifications to PTO, parental leave examples, and expense receipts (no policy changes). Managers: complete 12-18m training by Oct 20 and confirm via CSV. Link: <training link>. Open Q&A Thu 4pm PT."

nina-ic: Completed the micro-training 44d

omar-hr: I'll run the LDAP audit tomorrow and post the pre-merge CSV for review at /shared/hr/manager_candidates_plainlang.csv. Please flag missing leads within 24h.

liam-englead: Will validate and return any manual adds before EOD.

zoe-peopleops: Thanks all  final ack tracker will be posted by end-of-week. Q&A drop-in calendar invite sent for Fri 9:30am PT. If anything reads like a substantive policy change, call it out in this thread immediately. :eyes:
